questions.subject: MARKETING
questions.stem: Halcyon Pet Products, a midsize firm knows a Hillcrest product has a minor safety flaw but launches it anyway without disclosure, hoping no one notices. What is the main ethical problem?
questions.explanation: Marketers have a responsibility not to harm consumers and to provide information they need for safe use. Launching a product with a known flaw without disclosure puts profit ahead of safety and violates that duty, regardless of how minor the flaw seems. The firm cannot simply outsource its ethical responsibility to regulators.
questions.hint: Consider consumer safety and the duty to disclose known risks.
